CREATE VIEW [STAR].[DIM_Employees] AS
SELECT
	T1.[SATZ_ID],
	T1.[DAT_VON_HIST],
	T1.[DAT_BIS_HIST],
	T1.[LastName],
	T1.[FirstName],
	T1.[Title],
	T1.[TitleOfCourtesy],
	T1.[BirthDate],
	T1.[HireDate],
	T1.[Address],
	T1.[City],
	T1.[Region],
	T1.[PostalCode],
	T1.[Country],
	T1.[HomePhone],
	T1.[Extension],
	T1.[Photo],
	T1.[Notes],
	T1.[ReportsTo],
	T1.[PhotoPath],
	T1.[EmployeeID]
FROM
	[DWH].[DIM_Employees] T1
